correctness.rationale: Exact executable enumeration finds 783 graph simple cycles and precisely six disjoint triples. All six signed product cycles are checked in the 6528-column reduced Swiatkowski chain group against the full differential and have zero integral boundary. The displayed 6-by-6 coordinate minor is a signed permutation matrix and thus unimodular, giving a primitive rank-six torus sublattice. Exact integer elimination removes 6515 unit pivots; three independent integral relations and mod-101 rank six show the residual nine columns have rational rank six. Therefore full H3 is free rank seven, and saturated rank-six torus image has free cyclic cokernel. Verified by directly executing embedded code.

value.rationale: The natural geometric question is whether all top-dimensional classes of the canonical symmetric Pappus graph arise from moving three particles independently around disjoint cycles. The exact answer is no: exactly six products form a primitive Z^6, missing one free class of \(H_3\cong\mathbb Z^7\). This is a complete integral product-lattice classification for this graph and contrasts with the same graph’s complete two-particle product-torus generation. No paper-sized extension or speculative downstream theorem is needed for the self-contained obstruction.
